messages:
alex: Quick pulse — follow-up from Friday's postmortem. We agreed to tighten rollout safety but we need concrete, testable changes. I'm sketching an experiment: 3-tier ramp with automatic rollback triggers + per-flag blast radius caps. Want owners/ETA by EOD tomorrow.

mona: +1. Can you share the concrete triggers? error-rate? latency? user-impact?

raj: Prefer combining health signals (5xx rate) with business signals (checkout failures). Pure latency spikes are noisy. Also: we should avoid global rollback for noisy regions.

alex: Good point. Proposal: auto-rollback if 5xx_rate > 2.5% for 5min AND checkout_error_rate > 0.5% in the affected cohort. Rollout tiers: 1% -> 10% -> 50%. Each tier stays for 30m min.

sam: Do we want a hard blast-radius cap per feature? e.g., max 20% for first 72h even if rollout scheduled for more. Safer for platform-wide features.

mona: Draft config snippet (for the rollout controller):

```
flag: payment_v2
ramp: [1,10,50]
min_stage_duration: 30m
auto_rollback:
  when:
    - metric: http_5xx_rate
      threshold: 2.5
      window: 5m
    - metric: checkout_error_rate
      threshold: 0.5
      window: 5m
blast_radius_cap: 20
```

raj: That looks reasonable. Two concerns: (1) metric cardinality — ensure we evaluate at the cohort level, not global, (2) alert fatigue. We need synthetic canary tests to validate before ramp.

alex: Action items: 1) mona to implement rollout controller change + unit tests (owner: mona, ETA: 2025-06-10). 2) raj to add cohort-level aggregation and synthetic canary checks (owner: raj, ETA: 2025-06-08). 3) sam to draft blast-radius policy and docs (owner: sam, ETA: 2025-06-09). I'll own a 48h validation after rollout runs.

ops-bot: INC-2025-043 updated: added follow-up actions [mona, raj, sam] and linked to postmortem doc https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2025-043

sam: Acknowledge. I'll start the policy doc and include rollback examples + recommended dashboards. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — let's reconvene Fri 10am to review PRs and pick the safe defaults for the team.
